ShortDescription.Value: A cheat mod that keeps your city budget positive with configurable automatic boosts.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Budget Booster
A cheat mod that keeps your city budget positive, so you can build without watching the bank balance.
This is a cheat mod. If managing your city's finances is the part of the game you enjoy, it is not for you. If you would rather spend your time designing, it takes care of the money.
## Boost modes
Pick how the mod tops you up in Options / Mods / Budget Booster.
- Auto-Balance: adds money only when your balance drops below a target you set, and only enough to recover. It works as a safety net, not infinite cash. - Fixed Boost: adds a set amount every cycle, a steady income for creative building. - Percentage: reads your city's actual total expenses from the game's budget system and adds a percentage of them, so the boost grows as your city does.
## Quick presets
Each preset sets up all the options in one click.
- Casual Builder: $250K Auto-Balance. Light help that still leaves some challenge. - Sandbox Mode: $5M Fixed Boost, for building without limits. - Growing City: Percentage mode at 25%. Scales with the city, so there is less to adjust. - Emergency Only: $50K at $0. A safety net against bankruptcy and nothing more.
## Settings
The in-game options menu has sliders for boost amount, target surplus, boost percentage, a maximum per cycle safety cap, and how often the mod checks. Options that do not apply to your chosen mode are hidden.
## Session statistics
Shows boosts applied, total money added, your last boost, and current balance. Counters cover the current session and reset when you restart the game.
## Notifications
You can turn them off, or pick a level: minimal (only large boosts), normal, or detailed (adds balance and running totals).
## Diagnostics
The Debug section has detailed logging and a **Run Diagnostics** button. The button writes a full report to the log: the mod's status, your settings, and whether it can read your city's money and expenses. If something looks wrong, check that report first. It is also the most useful thing to attach to a bug report.
## Compatibility
- Works on existing saves. You can install or remove it at any time. - Removing the mod leaves your money alone, and your save stays compatible with the base game. - May conflict with other mods that change the economy or write to the city's money.
## Bugs and feedback
Report issues on GitHub with your game version, the mod version, the output of **Run Diagnostics**, and steps to reproduce.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Percentage mode now scales with your city's real expenses, read from the game's budget system. Before this it always fell back to scaling the Boost Amount slider, so it never grew with your city. If you already use Percentage mode, expect larger boosts. You may want to lower the percentage. - Fixed session statistics being saved to disk. They added up across restarts while labelled as per-session. They now reset each time you launch the game. - Fixed settings being written under two different names internally, which could leave configuration stranded. Existing settings are migrated automatically on first launch.
